description: One value comparator in 4HP with offset knobs, an adjustable tolerance, all six comparison results, a crossing trigger and a clamp output

params.text: Adds its voltage to the A input, and with that jack empty sets A on its own, -10V to +10V
Adds its voltage to the B input, and with that jack empty sets B on its own, -10V to +10V
Sets how far apart two values may be while counting as equal, 0V to 10V, and a twenty-fourth of a volt unless you move it
Attenuates and inverts the tolerance CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0% so that jack does nothing until you turn it

inputs.text: The signal passed by any of the six comparison outputs that comes out true; with the jack empty a true output carries the level set on the menu
The signal passed by any of the six comparison outputs that comes out false; with the jack empty a false output carries the level set on the menu
One of the two voltages being compared, added to its offset knob
Adds its voltage to the tolerance knob after the trim, widening or narrowing what counts as equal

outputs.text: Carries the true signal while A and B are within the tolerance of each other
Carries the true signal while A and B are further apart than the tolerance
Carries the true signal while A is greater than B or within the tolerance of it
Carries the true signal while A is greater than B by more than the tolerance
Carries the true signal while A is less than B or within the tolerance of it
Carries the true signal while A is less than B by more than the tolerance
Fires a 1ms trigger when A crosses B and gets clear of the tolerance on the far side
Carries A held within the tolerance either side of B, so at a tolerance of 1V it never strays more than a volt from B

notes: with both signal jacks empty the comparison runs on the two offset knobs alone, which is the way to compare one signal against a fixed voltage
the tolerance jack does nothing while its trim knob is centred, whatever is patched into it
menu: True output level — sets the voltage a true output carries when the True input is empty, 10V unless you change it
False output level — sets the voltage a false output carries when the False input is empty, 0V unless you change it
Set tolerance — sets the tolerance knob to a named value, from 0.00001V up to 5V, with the musical intervals labelled in notes
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Trigger-high output-level — sets the voltage a trigger pulse carries during its 1ms high phase, 10V unless you change it
Trigger-low output-level — sets the voltage a trigger output carries between pulses, 0V unless you change it

inputs.0:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads the True output level from the menu.
inputs.1:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads the False output level from the menu.
inputs.2:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V, leaving the A offset knob alone.
inputs.3:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V, leaving the B offset knob alone.
inputs.4:
±10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
